{"id":2041711857,"question_id":4318,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 month","timestamp":1782107904,"status":15,"status_display":"Runtime Error","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/2041711857/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Valid Subarrays With Matching Sum Digits I","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int countValidSubarrays(vector<int>& nums, int x) {\n        vector<int>pref(nums.size() , 0);\n        pref[0] = nums[0];\n        for(int i = 1 ; i<nums.size() ; i++) pref[i] = pref[i-1] + nums[i];\n\n        int count = 0;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<nums.size() ; i++)\n        {\n            for(int j = i ; j<nums.size() ; j++)\n            {\n                int sum = pref[j] - ((i-1) >= 0 ? pref[i-1] : 0);\n\n                int val = sum;\n\n                int lastDigit = val % 10;\n\n                while(val >= 10) val /= 10;\n\n                int firstDigit = val;\n\n                if(firstDigit == x and lastDigit == x) count++;\n            }\n        }\n        return count;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"valid-subarrays-with-matching-sum-digits-i","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2204}
